Name: Ermey
Description: Ermey was a drill instructor with the Green Lantern Corps and trained such notable Lanterns like Kilowog and Tomar Re. Ermey was particularly difficult on Kilowog, intentionally mispronouncing his name and chastising him for calling his pregnant wife during basic training. Ermey was fond of training his cadets on a unique planet which was split into four very distinct climates and terrain. There the ring less cadets faced many trials such as climbing hand over hand over a pit of lava, trekking through a desert filled with sinkholes, enduring freezing waters, and fighting a massive squid under the sea.
